comment: Shared banned-pattern list for Prism v3 untrusted-code screening. Read by BOTH sides: (1) the Rust intake scanner in crates/prism-recipe/src/zip_submit.rs (include_str!, hard reject at submission intake) and (2) the harness-side AST audit in prismlib/cheatguard.py (soft flag into the run report under cheatguard.ast_findings). Keep both consumers in sync when editing; unknown keys must be ignored by readers.
